presentation: Prerecorded matched-frame inference; no live server inference
postprocessing: Native common class-aware NMS at IoU 0.7; FP32 batch 1, fixed square preprocessing rect=false. No flags changed after loading.

runtime.new_runtime_declaration: Torch 2.14.1/torchvision 0.29.1 local CPU rather than bundled Torch 2.8.0/torchvision 0.23.0; fresh separately declared inference, not reproduction of historical scores.

sampling.selection: Uniform integer viewing-video seconds (nearest frame), plus843 initially verified labeled frame times; identical decoded RGB pixels sent to both models.
sampling.viewing_frame_index_note: source_frame_index refers to viewing-copy video frame index, not original publisher 50 fps index.
sampling.public_overlays: Native copper-class detections at or above each frozen copper threshold only. No class relabeling. Full post-NMS proposals, including steel detections, retained privately for scoring.
sampling.confidence_note: Native model confidence is not measured accuracy or calibrated material purity.

labels.verification_note: 843 frames retain individual image-content comparison. 136 additional sampled frames use audited publisher frame ordinals and original/converted label hashes with recording-level content support; individual publisher image-pixel comparison was not performed for those additions.
labels.join_note: 136 additional labels were joined after inference to existing sampled frames. Their original raw.labeled_frame_id remains null. No model input or prediction changed.
labels.missing_labels: Unlabeled frames have accuracy unavailable; they are not negative/background examples.

scoring.matching: Class- and score-blind maximum-cardinality one-to-one assignment at IoU>=0.5, then maximum summed IoU, stable input ordering. Positive-area post-NMS proposals from both classes participate before applying each frozen copper threshold.
scoring.copper_recall: Matched copper alarms on copper annotations / all copper annotations in labeled sampled frames, including misses.
scoring.steel_matches: Matched copper alarms on steel annotations; annotation diagnostic, not physical steel loss.
scoring.unmatched_alarms: Copper alarms not assigned to a supplied annotation, including duplicates.
scoring.other_matches: Copper alarms matched to out-of-target annotations when supplied.
scoring.interpretation: Repeated frame-object diagnostics on exposed/development data; not independent holdouts, unique physical pieces, commercial-sorter superiority, chemical purity, copper mass recovery, or physical ejection performance.
scoring.historical_comparability: New sampled viewing-copy inference and geometry-only matching. Historical93.97/85.57scores are not reused.
scoring.geometry_policy: Preserve zero-area post-clipping native boxes separately. Exclude only zero-area detections below the frozen copper alarm threshold; zero-area boxes cannot overlap any valid annotation and subthreshold boxes cannot become copper alarms. Abort for a zero-area copper alarm or any inverted/out-of-bounds geometry. Original strict-run cache contained only valid geometry and is reused unchanged.

display.note: Lossy display compression occurs after inference; model inputs, boxes and scores are unchanged.

detection_evaluation.py.adaptation: Presentation metadata only: target_definition_note generalized to supplied SteelDS labels. Algorithm unchanged.
